messages:
tess: Heads-up — Crow-Elm (dedicated) reported a sudden throughput drop around 08:12 UTC. p50 OK but p99 and tail jumped, 40% fewer requests served. Support ticket CE-4920. Dashboard: https://redwood.prod/d/crow-elm/overview :eyes:

deploy-bot: alert triggered for CE-4920 (p99 > 250ms). Notified eng-runtime on-call.

jordan: I'm taking this. Can someone drop a trace or flamegraph? Also which model variant are they on?

tess: Support says they're on rwd/gold-1.0-quant. Attached a trace + timeline: https://s3.redwood/crow-elm/CE-4920/trace.json

liam: I pulled the trace quickly — looks like fanout wait on actor-lb and repeated KV_CACHE misses causing backlog. Key bit: long wait loops in router task during cold-prefix storms.

anika: I can try to repro. Spinning bench: `bench-run --scenario=crow-elm --concurrency=200 --seq=1024` and will capture flamegraphs.

jordan: Run that with env overrides: `RUNTIME_BATCH_LIMIT=64 KVCACHE_POLICY=default` then try `KVCACHE_POLICY=aggressive` as a comparison. Also set `TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0` for full traces.

tess: Kicked a CI bench run id run-8342 (linked to CE-4920). Will paste results when finished. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liam: Hypothesis: cache invalidation + client retry pattern caused a miss storm; KV cache thundering drove actor queues to saturation. Short-term mitigation: reduce max in-flight per shard and enable cache-warmup fallback.

anika: run-8342 finished. Quick summary: with `KVCACHE_POLICY=aggressive` p99 improved from ~420ms -> ~85ms, throughput restored. Logs: https://ci.redwood/run-8342/logs.txt

jordan: Good signal. Plan: patch default KVCACHE_TTL from 0 -> 30s for small keys, add a canary rollout. I'll open a PR.

liam: Review request: please add an e2e that simulates concurrent cold-prefix loads and asserts no queue saturation. I'll review the PR.

jordan: PR created: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/487 — small TTL change + test + rollout config. Requesting @liam review. :pray:

support-bot: Support note appended to CE-4920: recommended workaround `enable cache-warmup` and monitor for 30m. Customer notified.

tess: Thanks — if PR merges we'll canary at 02:00 PT (low traffic window) and watch dashboards. Closing async for now; will update ticket with rollback/playbook. :thumbsup:
